---
name: Field proposal
about: Propose a new column, or a change to an existing one
labels: field-proposal
---

**What observation cannot be recorded today?**
<!-- A field is justified by data that exists and has nowhere to go. -->

**Which block does it belong to, and why that one?**
<!-- identity / composition / process / geometry / structure / properties /
     moisture / provenance. If it could sit in two, say which and why. -->

**Proposed name, type and unit**
<!-- SI unit in the name, e.g. hdt_stddev_c. -->

**Is it derivable from existing columns?**
<!-- If yes, it usually should not be a column. "One fact, one place." -->

**Who states it, and can it be verified?**
<!-- Vendor claim, measurement, or fitted value? Vendor claims are recorded as
     published and never inferred. -->

**Source(s) that would populate it**
<!-- Link a dataset, datasheet or paper. A field with no source is a guess. -->
